court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: Executive Authority Tuticorin Municipal Corporation and Another .…. Respondents.
judgment_text:
PRYAER: Writ Petition is under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for the issuance of a writ of Writ of Mandamus, forbearing the 1st respondent, from demanding and initiating any coercive steps to recover the Property Tax, with respect to the properties in Town Survey Numbers 1486/1B, 1486/1A belong to the petitioners, pursuant to the Property Tax Assessment Nos. 25003011, 2500312, 25003013, 25003014, 25003015, 25003016, 25003017, 25003018, 25003019, 25003020, 25003021, 25003022, 25003023, 25003024, 25003025, 25003026, 310853, 310869, 310870 and 310871 received by the petitioners on 31.07.2015 during the pendency of the statutory un-numbered Appeal Petition filed by the petitioners on 24.08.2015 before the second respondent.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Anita Sumanth, J.:— Learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. In view of the endorsement made by learned counsel for the petitioners, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
